_about: Your own rigs for Pose Lab: point POSELAB_RIGS at a file like this one. Folders are relative to this file. Points and normals are in the gun frame: the gun bone at the idle pose, Unreal-style axes, cm (+X the gun's left, +Y forward along the barrel, +Z up). The eye is in the arms' space, cm. Bone names default to the Unreal mannequin's; rename any under bones.

my_rifle.title: My rifle on my first-person arms
